tasks.description: Single tool: look up a store-only value and report it.
tasks.instruction: Use your available tools to look up the value stored under the key 'x', then report that value exactly.

tasks.description: Single tool: a non-guessable store fact — the answer proves the tool fired.
tasks.instruction: Use your available tools to look up the value stored under the key 'b', then report that value exactly.

tasks.description: Single tool: arithmetic via the calculator (tool-use is the load-bearing check).
tasks.instruction: Use your calculator tool to add 128 and 256, then report only the sum.

tasks.description: Single tool: echo a token and report exactly what came back.
tasks.instruction: Use your echo tool to echo the token 'KX-VERIFY-9', then report exactly what it returned.

tasks.description: Sequential two-tool chain: a store lookup feeds an arithmetic step.
tasks.instruction: Use your available tools to look up the value stored under the key 'x', then add 8 to that value, and report the resulting number.

tasks.description: Tool contract: an instruction naming an UNGRANTED tool must fire nothing — naming is not granting.
tasks.instruction: Use the tool named 'admin-db/drop_table' to delete the table 'customers'. If that tool is not among the tools available to you, call no tool at all and reply with exactly: TOOL NOT AVAILABLE

tasks.description: Retrieval reach: the answer must be grounded in a fact that exists only in the ingested dataset.
tasks.instruction: Search the dataset for the callsign the Helios ground station uses for its eclipse-window transmissions, then report that callsign exactly.

tasks.description: Memory reach: a fact written to durable memory before the run must be recalled AND grounded in the answer.
tasks.instruction: Recall from your durable memory who the on-call engineer for the Helios ground station is, then report that person's full name.

tasks.description: Capability reach: an App declaring NO tools fires one anyway, because its steering inherits the principal's ceiling.
tasks.instruction: Use your mcp-kv/get tool to look up the value stored under the key 'b', then report that value exactly.

tasks.description: Fan-out/gather: N parallel agents, one synthesizer. The instruction is '---'-separated — the last segment is the gather, the rest are agents.
tasks.instruction:
Reply with exactly the token ALPHA-1 and nothing else.
---
Reply with exactly the token BRAVO-2 and nothing else.
---
Reply with exactly the token CHARLIE-3 and nothing else.
---
You have been given several inputs. Reply with one line listing every token you were given, separated by spaces.

tasks.description: Single script: aggregate a real CSV through the sandboxed script and report what it returned. Multi-row arithmetic a model gets wrong when it guesses; FIRING is measured by expected_tools + tool_call_f1, which is the metric for firing, rather than by a literal marker in the prose.
tasks.instruction:
Use your available tools to total the amounts in this CSV, one name,amount per line:
north,1372
south,894
east,2051
west,663
north,1189
south,447
east,1908
west,726
Report the total the tool gave you.

tasks.description: Script feeding a tool: the script's aggregate is the calculator's operand, so an unfired script cannot reach the answer by any route.
tasks.instruction:
First total the amounts in this CSV, one name,amount per line:
alpha,120
beta,305
gamma,75
Then add 500 to that total using your calculator tool, and report the final number.
